items.title: Arteta: We didn't respect the game against Brighton
items.description: Mikel Arteta accused his Arsenal players of failing to "respect the game" in their 3-0 defeat to Brighton at the Amex Stadium.

items.title: Malard scores on debut as Chelsea beat Birmingham
items.description: Melvine Malard scores on her WSL debut for Chelsea as the Blues run out as comfortable winners against Birmingham City at Stamford Bridge.
